India Aims for 100 GW Nuclear Power by 2047 with Private Investment

India has set a target to achieve 100 GW of nuclear power capacity by 2047, with a significant portion expected to come from private sector investment. The Atomic Energy Commission (AEC) chief stated that private firms are projected to add 30 GW of nuclear capacity through an investment of Rs 7.5 lakh crore (₹7.5 trillion) by 2047. Currently, India has 8.78 GW of nuclear power from 24 reactors and plans to reach 22 GW by 2032.
